description_en: Call the DescribeSQAConfig operation to query the Short Query Acceleration (SQA) configuration for a cluster

kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-sqa-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id am-8vbyw9awuj141haf9 --group-name test --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSQAConfig

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

地域ID。
